researchNotes: Names taken from the Cologne Sprays collection (299 results, 7 pages) on demeterfragrance.com, the Demeter Fragrance Library storefront; product names there carry the suffix 'Cologne Spray', which was stripped from the name and recorded as concentration. That site does not mention The Library of Fragrance; the equivalence (European trade name of Demeter Fragrance Library, New York) comes from a web search result summarising https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demeter_Fragrance_Library. thelibraryoffragrance.com shows only a 'Launching Soon' page. Collection page lists no notes, so notes are empty for all entries; no notes inferred from names. Items not in the Cologne Sprays collection (other formats, sets, Dark Flowers etc.) were not enumerated. Black Tea and Swimming Pool showed 'Sold Out' on the listing (not marked discontinued). Second pass: product descriptions read from demeterfragrance.com/products.json (same scent text across purse spray/body formats; the Cologne Spray listings are mostly absent from that feed). Notes recorded only where the description names ingredients or notes explicitly (81 fragrances: 6 with top/heart/base, rest flat); prose-only single-note descriptions left empty. No perfumer, family or accords published; year only for Zombie (2013). Amber and Aloe Vera had no matching product in the feed.
